newsitem.title: USA: SmithKline starts human first episode herpes trial.
newsitem.headline: SmithKline starts human first episode herpes trial.

text.p: SmithKline Beecham Plc said Tuesday that it has started a worldwide clinical trial of Famvir, to determine whether a single 10-day treatment regimen for first-episode gential herpes can stop future outbreaks.

SmithKline said that preclinical data showed that there was no evidence of the herpes virus in Famvir-treated mice four months after treatment stopped, but the virus was evident in mice treated with another antiviral agent, valacyclovir.
The company said that the trial is designed to determine the ability of Famvir, or famiciclovir, to change the natural course of herpes and prevent the virus from reactiviating.
Famvir is already approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to treat recurrent genital herpes but not first-episode genital herpes.
